description: Implementation of a video decoder using FFmpeg, including buffer management, decoding, and frame processing, specialized for the 'FFMPEG' configuration.

classes.name: VideoDecoderImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: FFmpeg-based video decoder implementation with buffer management, decoding, and frame processing.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffers for video frames, supporting different FFmpeg API versions.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the FFmpeg codec context and prepares for decoding.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the FFmpeg codec context.

methods.name: DecodePacket
methods.description: Decodes a given AVPacket into a video frame.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedFrame
methods.description: Processes a decoded AVFrame, creating a CpuVideoFrame and notifying the decoder status.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Creates and updates the decode target from a video frame.

methods.name: DecoderThreadFunc
methods.description: Main decoding thread loop handling input events and decoding frames.
